contexts.text: The luminaries shall be... for days, and for years ()... There are alternations of spiritual and celestial things, in the universal, and in the singulars, that are compared to the alternations of days and years... those of years are from spring to summer, then to autumn, and through winter to spring...
The years, and numbers of years, that occur in (). Explained.
The midst of the years () = the advent of the Lord...
Years = states. AC 2636.
Years () = times and states in special. AC 487.
That days = states in general; and years, states in special. Illustrated. AC 493.
The number of years does not = the period of the life of any man; but the times and states of the Church.

Any whole period is designated in the Word by a day, week, month, or year, even though it be a hundred or a thousand years... for, in the internal sense, a day, and a year = nothing but time; and, from time, state; and therefore a year, in the Word, is used for time and state. Illustrated.
A hundred years () = the state of that Church at the beginning. ( = in general. AC 1332.)
Two years after the flood () = the second post-diluvian Church; for a year, in the Word... = an entire period, less or greater, of fewer or of more years.
Years = duration and state. AC 1341. AC 1344. AC 1346. AC 1347. AC 1348. AC 1350. AC 1352. AC 1354. AC 1375.
Thousands of years do not appear to the Angels as time...
Under Three, see this reference.
The Church (as) compared to the times of the year. Enumerated. AC 2323. AC 2905:2.
My experience for many years. AC 1886, Preface. [3]. AC 1966.
Ninety-nine years () = the time before the Lord fully conjoined the internal man with the rational.

A year then intervened, because by a year, in the Word, is not signified a year, but an entire time, thus a whole period, whether of a thousand years, or of a hundred, or ten, or one of hours. References.
Goods of infancy are up to the tenth year; goods of ignorance, to the twentieth year; and from this year man begins to be rational.
Gentiles can be initiated into choirs in one night; while most Christians scarcely can in thirty years. SE 3494.
Under Hundred, see this reference. AC 2905.
The years of the lives of Sarah () = while any truth Divine remained; for a year = an entire period of the Church from beginning to end; thus years = periods. AC 2906:2, Illustrated.
The year of the good pleasure of Jehovah (); the year of My redeemed (); and the year of visitation () = the time of a new Church, (and the Lord's advent.) AE 295:7. AE 413:6. AE 413:7. AE 612:5.
In the posterity of years () = the last time of the Church, which then becomes no Church.
Thou art come unto thy years () = to the end, when the Lord withdraws from the Church.
Within three years () = the end of the former Church.
Seventy years () = the entire period, from the time when the Church began, until it expires.
That a year, and also years = the entire period of a Church, or the time of its duration. Illustrated.
As in ancient years () = the Ancient Church.
That a year, and years = the full time of a Church. Illustrated.

As a year, and years, when predicated of the... Church = the full time between the two limits, which are the beginning and the end, so they = what is eternal when predicated of the Lord's Kingdom in Heaven. Illustrated.

The Angels can have no idea of a year; but as a year, in nature, is a fulness of time... therefore, instead of a year they have the idea of what is full in relation to the state of the Church, and of what is eternal in relation to the state of Heaven. Times, to them, are states.
The days of the years of the life of Abraham () = a state representative of the Lord as to the Divine Itself...
In that year () = the entire state here treated of.
Forty years = states of temptation.
When a year, etc. is mentioned in the singular number, it = an entire state, thus the end of a preceding, and the beginning of a subsequent, state.
I will serve thee seven years () = study, and then a holy state... Years = states.
These twenty years have I been with thee () = ... states of the proprium.
A son of seventeen years () = the state of (the Lord's Divine spiritual Human). Explained.
At the end of two years of days () = after the state of conjunction.
The seven good kine are seven years () = states of the multiplication of truth in the interior Natural. AC 5266. AC 5268.
There come seven years () = states of Providence.
Seven years of famine () = the states that follow when there is a failing of truth. AC 5360. AC 5893. AC 5894.

In the seven years of plenty () = in those times when truths with goods were multiplied. Years = states, and therefore also times... The reason years = ... times also, is that in the internal sense, years = entire states, that is, entire periods, from the beginning of a state, to the end; and these periods cannot be expressed otherwise than by times, nor apprehended, by those who are in time, except as times. AC 5294. (Compare AC 5339. AC 5340.)
Joseph was a son of thirty years () = a full state of remains... Years = states.
How many are the days of the years of thy life? () = (a perception) concerning the state of the natural life from the spiritual. Days, and years = states. AC 6095. AC 6097. AC 6098.
In this year () = the period of that state; for a year = an entire period from beginning to end. AC 6130.
Seventeen years () = the state there... Thus the beginning of the state... even unto its end.
For many years I have observed...
A year = a period of life from beginning to end; here... a period of life from the beginning to eternity.
The son of a year () = a full state; for a year = an entire period from beginning to end, and thus a full state. Explained.
(The years of Israel in Egypt. Explained.)
From year to year () = constantly... For a year = an entire period from beginning to end.
Forty years () = a state of all temptations.
The age of men (in Jupiter) according to the years of our Earth, is for the most part thirty years. Explained.
Six years shall he serve () = a state of labour and of some combat, and of the consequent confirmation of truth... Years = states.
In the seventh year () = a state of the conjunction of good and truth; here, a state of confirmed truth.
Three years and six months () = to the full.
This cannot be effected, except... in the course of many years.
Six years thou shalt sow the land () = the first state when the man... is being instructed...
In the seventh year thou shalt intermit it... () = the second state, when the man... is in good...
Three times... in the year () = permanent worship... A year = an entire period; here, therefore, plenary and complete deliverance.
In the going out of the year () = the end of the works.
I will not drive him out... in one year () = no hasty removal of them.
The sons of a year () = the quality of infancy, in which, however, truths have been implanted.
Once in a year () = perpetually. AC 10211.
From a son of twenty years and upwards () = a state of intelligence of truth and good... For when a man arrives at twenty years, he begins to think from himself.

Man's first state is from birth to the fifth year of his age... His second is from the fifth to the twentieth year... The third is from the twentieth to the sixtieth year... The fourth is from the sixtieth year and upwards... Illustrated, Explained.
The year (in the Fifth Earth) contains about 200 days... of 15 hours each, relatively to (our time).
The year (in the Sixth Earth) contains 200 days... of 9 hours each of our time.
It is from this correspondence that... year, in the Word, = the state of life in general.
After a succession of years (in Heaven)...
From the earliest times, some thousands of years have elapsed.
Some remain (in the World of Spirits) for many years, but not beyond thirty. (Compare AR 866:2.)
The first state of man after death... with some lasts for a year, but rarely, with anyone, beyond a year.
As 100,000 years are nothing to eternity, what are a few years of life in the world? SE 3509.
For the time in a year is constantly 365 and 1/4 days.
Repentance is... to examine one's self once or twice in a year. AR 531:5. CL 529:end.
Prepared for... a year, etc. () = in the perpetual endeavour... AE 571.
The Last Judgment was executed in the year 1757. AR 865. AR 886. (See Last Judgment.)
Bound him a thousand years () = for some time. Explained. AR 844. AR 849. AR 850. AR 856.
6000 years reckoned since the creation.
We have clearly seen this here for thousands of years.
I have lived with my wife a thousand years.
When those who die as infants attain the stature of youths of eighteen years in the world, and maidens of fifteen years, they stay in it.
Finish your work on the Apocalypse within two years.
This Redemption commenced in the year 1757, together with the Last Judgment...

See Swedenborg. WE 5315. SE 192. SE 219. SE 461. SE 821. SE 1166. SE 1974:2. SE 2072. SE 3464:2. SE 4228. AC 5. HH 1:4. EU 1:end. AE 1147:3. LJCont 35. DWis 7. 1. DLW 355:2. AR 784:end. Letters 4. CL 1. TCR 12:end. TCR 157. TCR 281. TCR 851. Letters 29. Inv 43.
Concerning the year 1657... The number 57, or 1657, shown me. See SE 2690.
Some methods of vexation, and thus of inauguration into gyres... persist for thousands of years.
On those who lived from 1000 to 4000 years ago... They are just the same now as they were then.
This penalty recurs... for many years, if not for hundreds, or thousands, of years...
One who has been in the other life for from 3000 to 4000 years, said that he knows there are gyres or revolutions of Things...
In the other life, they who have lived thousands of years, do not know that they have lived a minute.
To investigate which was the labour of many years.
A place where many Souls were flitting about, who had lived from 2000 to 4000 years ago, and had been vastated...
A Hell where they lie... for 10, 50, 100, 1000, 2000 years...
These are such as have arrived from the world within the last 10 to 20 years, who minister to men.
With those who come from the world this (changing of the love) lasts, with some... years, up to 50. SE 5693. SE 5694.
From the beginning of the year 1757...
The Lord sees... what is the next sequent thing, after 100, or 1000, years.
Their nature lasts for many years, before it suffers itself to be mastered.
The years of generation and generation () = the Ancient Church.
He shall not be anxious in the year of drought () = that in a state in which there is no truth and good he shall not be in fear of the loss of them.
Within three years () = what is complete and consummated.
Thy years shall have no end () = the states of Divine truth.
A year above a year shall ye be troubled () = that with such, truths are successively diminished, and in every state.
